prompt.alinti: Assume your idea is brilliant, and everyone's about to steal it. So build in stealth. Show nothing until launch day. Get your market size from a chart, not from a customer. Learn nothing surprising from your users, and only do things that scale.

Put your tech stack in the first paragraph. Start with the solution. Mention the problem near the end. Describe the product for a page. Traction at the bottom. If you have three users, don't say three. Back nothing with evidence. Oversell. Pick a claim they can't check. Rush the 50-character description. Spend the week on the deck. Leave a section blank. Leave your co-founder out of the video. Say they're busy. Hit submit and never touch it again.
